title: Polynomial-Time Length Bound Language
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function from finite binary strings to finite binary strings. The language of strings $z$ satisfying $|f(z)| \\le C\,(|g(z)|+1)^c$, where $g$ takes the first component of a parsed self-delimiting pair and returns the empty string if parsing fails, belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$.
